Notation

Source: vignettes/notation.Rmd
notation.Rmd

Symbols used throughout the package vignettes (see Leventer 2025, §2–3 for formal definitions):

Symbol Definition
G∈{f,m}G \in \{f,m\} Gender (female, male)
DD Age at first childbirth (treatment timing)
Yi,a(d)Y_{i,a}(d) Potential earnings of individual ii at age aa if first birth occurs at age dd
Yi,a(∞)Y_{i,a}(\infty) Potential earnings under never having a child
APO(g,d,a)=𝔼[Ya(∞)∣G=g,D=d]\text{APO}(g,d,a) = \mathbb{E}[Y_a(\infty) \mid G=g, D=d] Average counterfactual earnings
ATE(g,d,a)=𝔼[Ya(d)−Ya(∞)∣G=g,D=d]\text{ATE}(g,d,a) = \mathbb{E}[Y_a(d) - Y_a(\infty) \mid G=g, D=d] Average treatment effect of parenthood
θ(g,d,a)=ATE/APO\theta(g,d,a) = \text{ATE}/\text{APO} Normalised effect (proportional earnings change)
ρ(d,a)=APO(f,d,a)/APO(m,d,a)\rho(d,a) = \text{APO}(f,d,a) / \text{APO}(m,d,a) Gender earnings ratio (counterfactual)
Δρ(d,a)\Delta\rho(d,a) Effect of parenthood on the gender earnings ratio
